title: Checkpoint: the player lifecycle
prompt: Implement `Player`: constructor takes starting HP (position starts at 0). `move(steps)` advances position (works at any HP). `hit(dmg)` reduces HP but **never below 0**, and does nothing when HP is already 0. `heal(amount)` raises HP but does nothing when HP is 0 (the player is out). `getHp()` and `getX()` report state.

tests.name: player lifecycle
tests.hint: hit clamps at 0 and guards on hp > 0; heal guards on hp > 0; move has no guard.
